description.value: Tasty Donair is a Lebanese-inspired fast-food counter specializing in donairs, shawarma-style wraps, and Mediterranean plates built around hummus, tabouli, and falafel. The menu spans Lebanese, Turkish, and Greek plate combinations with chicken, beef, and veggie falafel fillings, offering a hearty and flavourful stop for hungry cyclists. The About Us page shares an engaging history of the döner/shawarma cooking tradition tracing back to Anatolia and the eastern Mediterranean.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and shows a real, active business with a full menu, gallery, and contact details, confirming the business exists. However, the OSM node is placed in Tsawwassen while every page of the website exclusively references a 'SURREY LOCATION' at 13711 72nd Avenue — the coordinates do not correspond to that Surrey address, suggesting the OSM node is either misplaced or represents a distinct (possibly closed) Tsawwassen branch not mentioned on the website. Amenity signals are sparse: the fast-food format and 'Order Now!' CTA confirm takeout; the menu's 'Veggie Felafel' option confirms vegetarian availability; no bike, washroom, water, or Wi-Fi details are present anywhere on the site.
concerns: Critical location mismatch: OSM node coordinates (49.1338716, -122.8426031) place the business in Tsawwassen, but the website exclusively references a 'SURREY LOCATION' at 13711 72nd Avenue, Surrey. No Tsawwassen address or branch is mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM node may be misplaced or represent a closed Tsawwassen location.
Two different email addresses appear on the website: tastydonair@gmail.com in the footer/contact details block, and tastydonair@shaw.ca on the contact page form.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM node is geolocated in Tsawwassen but the website lists only a Surrey location (13711 72nd Avenue); it is unclear whether a Tsawwassen branch exists or the node is misplaced — geographic verification is needed before the listing can be confidently included.
